# install-handler

Registers Centcom as the handler for centcom:// links in your own account (no sudo): a desktop entry on Linux, an app in ~/Applications on macOS, a registry entry under HKCU on Windows. --dry-run only lists what it would do; --uninstall removes what it made.

```
centcom install-handler [--uninstall] [--dry-run]
```

## Options

- `--uninstall`: remove the handler this command made
- `--dry-run`: list what would be done and change nothing
